identity.en: A slim thirty-year-old Saudi Arab man living in the year 2050
identity.text: شاب الجيل: سعودي حوالي ٣٠ سنة في عام ٢٠٥٠

face.en: Friendly oval face, warm brown eyes, neat dark eyebrows, short neatly trimmed black beard and mustache, curious gentle smile, warm light-brown skin, thin transparent rimless smart glasses with a faint cyan glint on the lenses
face.text: وجه بيضاوي ودود، لحية خفيفة مرتبة، نظارة ذكية شفافة

hair.en: Short neat black hair, slightly longer and swept up on top

build.en: Slim, average height, relaxed upright posture

top.en: a modern slim-cut white thobe with a clean band collar and a thin pale cyan piping line along the placket
top.text: ثوب أبيض عصري بقصة ضيقة وخط سماوي رفيع

bottom.en: the white thobe falling to the ankles and clean white minimalist sneakers
bottom.text: الثوب لين الكعب وجزمة رياضية بيضاء

details.en: the band collar of the white thobe and the single small button at the throat with the thin pale cyan piping
clean white minimalist sneakers under the hem of the white thobe

skin.en: Smooth healthy thirty-year-old skin drawn simply, no pores
